Name: Glasser360
Description: HCP-MMP1.0 cortical parcellation (Glasser et al. 2016), 360 parcels, from XCP-D. Named Glasser360 here because XCP-D has a built-in atlas called "Glasser" (the same parcellation) and stops when two atlas datasets share a name.
License: HCP Data Use Terms apply to the original release; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
ReferencesAndLinks: Glasser, M. F., Coalson, T. S., Robinson, E. C., et al. (2016). A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex. Nature, 536, 171-178. https://doi.org/10.1038/nature18933
